title: Estimating Spectrum-Free Information Bounds for Generative Surrogates Beyond Conditional Collapse
abstract: arXiv:2611.07826v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional generative surrogates in high-energy physics, such as models that predict reconstructed jets from partons, are often evaluated on $1\text{D}$ marginal divergences among other metrics. Taken alone these metrics can reward conditional collapse. On a CMS simulation benchmark, a sampler that ignores the conditioner beats a trained Mixture Density Network (MDN) on all four target marginals under both KL and Wasserstein-1, and cannot be stably separated from a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) model on two of the four. We instead score the models with the Continuous Ranked Probability Skill Score (CRPSS) from forecast verification, taking the exact marginal as the reference. We show how global skill depends on the evaluation spectrum, and we also report it within bins of a conditioning variable, where that dependence largely goes away. translated_title: 估计超越条件坍缩的生成式代理模型的无谱信息界
translated_abstract: 高能物理中的条件生成式代理模型（例如从部分子预测重建喷注的模型）通常在一维边缘散度等指标上进行评估。单独使用这些指标可能会奖励条件坍缩现象。在CMS模拟基准测试中，一个忽略条件输入的采样器在KL散度和Wasserstein-1距离下于所有四个目标边缘分布上都击败了经过训练的混合密度网络（MDN），并且在其中两个目标上无法与条件流匹配（CFM）模型稳定地区分开来。我们转而采用来自预报检验领域的连续分级概率技巧评分（CRPSS）来评估模型，并以精确的边缘分布作为参考。我们展示了全局技巧评分如何依赖于评估谱，同时也报告了在条件变量分箱内的技巧评分——在分箱内部这种依赖性基本消失。随后，我们引入了一种数据驱动的k近邻（k-NN）外推方法，用于估计……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 针对高能物理条件生成式代理模型评估中一维边缘散度指标会奖励条件坍缩的问题，本文提出采用预报检验领域的CRPSS技巧评分并以精确边缘分布为参考，同时引入数据驱动的k近邻外推方法来估计不受评估谱影响的无谱信息界，从而实现更可靠的模型评估。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that 1D marginal divergences alone can reward conditional collapse in conditional generative surrogates, and proposes scoring with the CRPSS (using exact marginals as reference) together with a data-driven k-NN extrapolation to estimate spectrum-free information bounds for more reliable evaluation.
